question: Kettle Brand avocado oil parent company
markdown:
Kettle Brand in the United States is owned by
the
Campbell Soup Company
, which acquired it through the purchase of Snyder's-Lance in 2018. In the UK and Europe, the brand is owned by the
Valeo Foods Group
, which bought the European division in 2019.
Wikipedia
Ownership History
Campbell Soup Company (2018–Present):
Owns the U.S. and general North American rights.
Valeo Foods Group (2019–Present):
Owns the UK and European operations.
Snyder's-Lance (2016–2018):
Bought Diamond Foods, which included Kettle Foods.
Diamond Foods (2010–2016):
Acquired the brand for $615 million.
Lion Capital (2006–2010):
A private equity group that owned the company prior to Diamond Foods.
Cameron Healy (1977–2006):
Founded the company in Salem, Oregon, originally starting as the N.S. Khalsa Company before launching Kettle Brand chips in 1982.
